prompt: Create a clean 3D-model reference board for an ordinary destructible small-town Midwestern house in the mobile arcade destruction game Severe Weather Warning. Art direction: storm-charged stylized Americana, polished low-poly/PBR-friendly forms, believable construction anatomy, instantly readable at phone distance. Design a modest one-and-a-half-story 1970s-1990s Heartland home with a pitched shingle roof, small covered porch, siding, visible corner trim, windows, front door, modest chimney, concrete foundation and one simple attached or detached garage element. Show one large 3/4 front view plus smaller front and side views with identical proportions. Roof planes, wall sections, porch, windows, trim and foundation must read as physically separate layers suitable for staged destruction and debris. Use restrained lived-in color variation and slightly weathered materials. Avoid primitive box-stack construction, voxel style, photorealism, toy plastic, huge landscaping, cars, people, signage, text, storm effects, or an overly elaborate mansion silhouette. Neutral background and studio lighting. The house should look authored and charming but common enough to repeat with material/color variations across a game town.
